text:
maya: Heads-up — did a dry-run of a tenant reprocess and the console estimate is way off (predicted 2h, actual ~9h). 
liam: ugh, which tenant and what job config?
maya: tenant: acme-inc, job: full-agg-recompute, window=30d, shard-parallelism=8, priority=standard
ana: (cc @ana) we definitely surface model of estimate — it should include hot-shard penalty and KV-cache warmup.
ana: sorry typo, cc @ana
ana: @maya can you paste the console preflight payload?
maya: pasted below: ```{"tenant":"acme-inc","type":"recompute","days":30,"parallelism":8}```
ana: looks like console's estimator ignored the small-key skew multiplier we added last month.
liam: that's the routing penalty from last deploy — it adds ~3x when hot-shards > 25%. Maybe the estimator query isn't reading it.
sam: quick ask: do we want cost estimate to show both nominal and worst-case? ops keeps getting paged when customers see the bill mismatch. :thinking_face:
jordan: yes — show best/expected/worst in UI. Also add a note about quota reservation vs actual consumption (reservation may block other jobs).
maya: UI change makes sense, but UX needs to avoid scaring users — maybe collapsed advanced section?
liam: backend: two immediate fixes: 1) ensure estimator fetches routing penalty flag, 2) apply conservative multiplier for tenants with recent hot-shard alerts.
nana: agreed. also need a ticket to mark jobs that used optimistic estimates so billing can be reconciled automatically.
sam: +1 on reconciliation. We should offer an opt-in chargeback preview email for tenants before large reprocesses.
jordan: ops-bot FYI scheduled maintenance window for reprocess cluster tonight 23:00–02:00 UTC, might increase observed runtimes during that window.
ops-bot: notice — maintenance task `node-compact` scheduled 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z to 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z; throttles may apply.
maya: great — that likely explains the run I saw at 02:30.
liam: plan: I'll push a hotfix to estimator to include penalty flags by EOD, @ana can you follow up on UI copy for three-tier estimate?
ana: will do, prepping mock text and a small tooltip explaining "why worst-case is higher".
sam: can we also add a console checkbox "reserve headroom tokens" which will pre-allocate quota to prevent preemption?
jordan: that interacts with the priority lane allocator — maybe a `reserve_tokens=true` flag when creating the job. Need product sign-off.
maya: opening a ticket now with logs and the two proposed fixes. tagging everyone. :thumbsup:
liam: cheers. once hotfix is live we'll run the same dry-run against acme-inc and compare.
nana: will draft UI copy and add screenshots to the ticket.
sam: and I'll prototype an email template for the chargeback preview.
maya: thanks team — major pain avoided if we reconcile estimates with routing rules.
liam: one more thought — add a small metric in telemetry: `recompute.estimate_error` (abs(actual/estimate)). Want gradual alert at >1.5.
jordan: love that. Put it on the reprocess dashboard so oncall can triage without paging.
maya: noted. ticket created: 5405006789 — linking here for follow-ups.
